hero.description: Lily Kwek kwek serves freshly cooked kwek-kwek and other popular street food in General Trias, Cavite. Our focus on cleanliness and new recipes makes us a favorite among locals. We offer a variety of sauces and free cucumber and onion for added flavor.

items.title: Kwek Kwek Delight
items.description: Our signature kwek kwek dish, served with a side of spicy vinegar and steamed cucumber. Made with freshly cooked quail eggs and a special blend of spices. Perfect for a quick snack or merienda.

items.title: Street Food Platter
items.description: A selection of our popular street food items, including kwek kwek, fish balls, and squid balls. Served with a variety of sauces and a side of cucumber and onion. Perfect for sharing with friends and family.

items.title: Merienda Special
items.description: A quick and easy snack pack, including a choice of kwek kwek, street food, or merienda item, paired with a drink and a side of cucumber and onion. Perfect for a busy day or on-the-go.
